newFindings.title: AXI pre-commit hook L3 trigger on `archive` paths
newFindings.description: axi-workspace-git-hooks preflight runs `workspace-flow.mjs preflight --staged --record` which executes `workspace-project-cli.mjs validate` + `pnpm workspace:audit`. The validator emits 57 pre-existing workspace-wide errors (admission/reconcile/contract-missing for unrelated projects). The L3 risk trigger comes from the keyword `archive` in moved paths. Owner should reconcile `workspace.graph.json` ↔ `workspace.json` separately and tighten the preflight classification to suppress L3 for `archive` paths inside `_archive/` subtrees, or fix the underlying governance drift.
newFindings.evidence: Agent 5 + Agent 6 both had to use `git commit --no-verify` to land their fixes. Both verified the bypass is documented in commit message and the pre-existing errors are unrelated to M18 changes.

newFindings.title: APFS hardlink traps lowercase-file shadow pattern
newFindings.description: On APFS (macOS workspace filesystem), lowercase `prd.md` shadow files of tracked uppercase `PRD.md` are often real APFS hardlinks sharing the same inode. Standard `rm`/`unlink` collapses both directory entries and removes the inode. To remove safely: rename `PRD.md` first (breaks the link), unlink `prd.md`, restore `PRD.md` from git. Confirmed at `axi-pet-desktop/docs/specs/2026-08-11-test-coverage-baseline/prd.md`. The `axi-image-preview/prd.md` was successfully removed (likely not a hardlink or different inode).
newFindings.evidence: Agent 4 attempted to unlink the lowercase shadow 3 times; each attempt collapsed the inode and required `git restore PRD.md` to recover. Tracked `PRD.md` was preserved at end of attempt.

newFindings.title: Per-project branch isolation pattern for cross-project fix agents
newFindings.description: M17 used 8 fix agents but several agents worked in projects with multi-agent overlap; landed 16 commits across 8 repos with some conflicts. M18 redesigned by exclusive project ownership: each fix agent owns 1+ projects exclusively. No cross-agent commit conflicts. Pattern: assign project clusters (governance / personal-OS / shared-foundation / workbench / axi-agent / products / candidates / workspace-root) with 1 fix agent per cluster. Branch naming convention: `agent/m18-fix-N-<scope>` or `fix/m18-doc-cleanup[-<agent>]`.
newFindings.evidence: M18 produced 0 cross-agent conflicts across 19 projects. 8-agent harness ceiling allows clean partition (recall [[feedback-harness-slot-limit-12-not-achievable]]).
